meta.name: analyzing-ethereum-smart-contract-vulnerabilities
meta.description: Perform static and symbolic analysis of Solidity smart contracts using Slither and Mythril to detect reentrancy, integer overflow, access control, and other vulnerability classes before deployment to Ethereum mainnet.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在部署前自动检测以太坊智能合约安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发以太坊智能合约并希望在上线前发现安全漏洞。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing Ethereum smart contracts and want to find vulnerabilities before mainnet deployment.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以使用 Slither 和 Mythril 工具自动分析以太坊 Solidity 智能合约，检测重入、整数溢出、访问控制等漏洞，并生成带 SWC 标识符和严重性评级的 JSON 审计报告。
howto.when: 当用户提供 Solidity 合约代码或合约地址，并要求进行安全分析时触发。

say.text: 请用 Slither 和 Mythril 分析我的智能合约。
say.note: Claude 将运行两种工具并汇总结果。

say.text: 检查这个合约是否有重入漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会重点查找重入类问题。

say.text: 审计我的合约，生成 JSON 报告。
say.note: 得到带有 SWC 编号和严重性评级的详细报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Slither and Mythril to analyze Ethereum Solidity smart contracts, detecting reentrancy, integer overflow, access control, and other vulnerabilities, and generate a JSON audit report with SWC identifiers and severity ratings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides Solidity contract code or address and requests a security analysis.

say_en.text: Run Slither and Mythril on my smart contract.
say_en.note: Claude will execute both tools and merge results.

say_en.text: Check this contract for reentrancy vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on reentrancy patterns.

say_en.text: Audit my contract and generate a JSON report.
say_en.note: Get a detailed report with SWC IDs and severity levels.
